claims.claim: For sale in working order (implied by the listing)

risks.risk: Machine may not power on, fill, drain or spin (motor, control board or pump fault).
risks.proof: A clip of the machine powered on, running a short cycle through fill, drum rotation, drain and spin, with the display lit.

risks.risk: Rust may extend to the base frame, back panel and inside the cabinet, weakening the shell or causing leaks.
risks.proof: Photos of the back, both sides and the underside/base with the machine tilted.
risks.if_unproven: as heavily rusted throughout, parts value

risks.risk: Door gasket torn or mouldy, or door lock faulty, causing leaks or refusal to start.
risks.proof: Close photo of the door open with the rubber gasket folded back all round, and the door locking at cycle start.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a new gasket and door lock

risks.risk: Drum bearings worn (common in old front loaders), noisy spin.
risks.proof: Clip of the spin cycle with sound, and of the drum turned by hand with the door open.

risks.risk: Exact model and age unknown; model code not legible.
risks.proof: Close photo of the rating plate on the back or inside the door rim.
risks.if_unproven: as the oldest LG DirectDrive 7kg front loader

proof_requests: Clip of the machine powered on and running a short cycle: fill, wash, drain and spin, with sound.
Close photo of the rating plate (back or door rim) showing model and serial.
Photos of the back, both sides and the base to show the extent of rust.
Photo with the door open showing the drum and the gasket folded back.
response.reason: Photo 0 clearly reads LG Inverter DirectDrive 7kg front loader, so it can be priced; with no running clip and visible rust it is priced at its worst case as an old, rusted, not working unit until proof is supplied.
